title: Cherry Cobblemon
description: Cobblemon Server featuring custom mods and no P2W
body:
# 🌌 [1.21.1 Fabric] Cobblemon Survival – No P2W • Custom Features • Active Development

A brand new **Fabric 1.21.1 Cobblemon server** focused on long-term progression, fair gameplay, and constantly evolving content. We’re about a month old and building something different — a survival-first Cobblemon experience without pay-to-win shortcuts.

- Discord Link: https://discord.gg/95mxCabJWf
- Server IP: **74.112.77.164:9060**
- Modpack: https://modrinth.com/modpack/cherry-cobblemon-modpack (only includes the basic big cobblemon mods and addons)

---

## 💎 Zero Pay-to-Win.
- ❌ No purchasable advantages  
- ❌ No admin-spawned items for players  
- ❌ No favoritism  

Everything is earned through gameplay. Admins don’t cheat. Progress actually means something here.

---

## 🛠️ Custom Mods & Active Development
We develop and maintain **custom Fabric mods** for the server. Features aren’t copy-pasted — they’re built and improved over time.

Expect:
- Frequent updates  
- New systems and mechanics  
- Community-driven improvements  

This isn’t a static server. It evolves.

---

## 🧬 AllTheMons Addon
We use the **AllTheMons** addon to greatly expand available Pokémon beyond the base Cobblemon roster.

- More variety  
- More team-building options  
- More long-term collection goals  

If you love completing Pokédex entries and building competitive teams, you’ll feel right at home.

---

## 💎 Core Gameplay Features

### 🌍 Survival-Focused Cobblemon
- True survival progression  
- Balanced economy  
- Resource gathering matters  

### 🌌 Ultra Wormholes
- Travel to dangerous, unique dimensions  
- Encounter rare and powerful Pokémon  
- Limited-time access windows  
- High risk, high reward exploration  

Wormholes tie into our progression systems and celestial events — they aren’t just portals, they’re endgame challenges.

### ⚔️ Custom Dungeon Mod
- Wave encounters 
- Trainer battles  
- Ambushes
- One time and repeatable rewards  

### 🧑‍🏫 NPC Trainers
- Battle trainers throughout the world  
- Increasing difficulty  
- Rewards for progression  

### 🏆 Raids
- Challenging raid encounters  
- Coordinated gameplay encouraged  
- Valuable rewards  

### 🌠 Celestial Events
- Custom world-changing events  
- Unique spawns and effects  
- Limited-time gameplay twists  

### 🎯 Quests
- Structured progression goals  
- Rewards that scale with effort  
- Long-term objectives  

### 🎲 Bingo
- Rotating challenge boards  
- Competitive & completion-based rewards  
- A fun break from standard grinding  

---

## 🔥 Competitive & Collection Features

- 🧬 Mega Evolution  
- 🔁 Global Trade System (GTS)  
- 🎁 Rotating Mystery Gifts  
- 🏪 In-game Shops with Multiple Currencies  
  - Different activities reward different currencies  
  - Encourages diverse gameplay styles  

---

## 🚀 Why Join Now?

We’re early. The server is about a month old, which means:
- The economy isn’t inflated  
- You won’t be years behind  
- You can help shape the direction of future features  

If you’re tired of pay-to-win Cobblemon servers and want something fair, evolving, and built with intention — this is it.

---

### Join us and grow with the server 🌱  
Fair progression. Custom content. No shortcuts.
